caption: The image shows a grayscale drawing or rubbing of a rectangular, bas-relief tablet or plaque. The main section of the composition depicts several animals, which appear to be ungulates such as deer or goats, placed amongst stylized trees with slender trunks and sparse branches. In the right section, there are two human figures standing upright between the trees. Below this scene is a horizontal band containing an inscription in a script that appears to be in a serif font; the text is partially legible and extends across the width of the plaque. The lower portion features an oval or elliptical shape containing the number “14”; this section is partially damaged or missing, especially at the bottom right corner where the surface is broken off. The entire plaque has a textured surface and the drawing itself is rendered in shades of gray on an off-white or sepia-toned background, with two small round holes visible in the upper left and lower left of the plaque. The image is bordered by a thin rectangular frame.
